title: Eel Bridge RPC API Contract for Excel Sidebar Reorganizer
description: Defines Eel exposed Python functions and expected JSON data payload schemas for frontend-backend communication.

endpoints.name: import_excel_file
endpoints.description: Imports an Excel file, reads sheet names, and returns headers for the first sheet.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the imported .xlsx file

endpoints.name: switch_active_sheet
endpoints.description: Switches active sheet and returns its unique sorted Row 1 headers.

sheet_name.description: Target sheet name to switch to

endpoints.name: export_reorganized_row1
endpoints.description: Exports tree structure as backslash leaf paths into Row 1 horizontally across columns for the active sheet.

tree_data.description: Hierarchical JSON array representing constructed forest/tree nodes
